paragraphs: From Tullamore Central Business Park, depart and turn left onto Clonminch Road
Follow this road for just over a kilometre take the next right onto Bachelor's Walk
Pull in safely on the left when instructed, as this is a good spot to practice a moving-off exercise before continuing
Moving off again from Bachelor's Walk, approach the roundabout and take the exit for Church Road on the left
Continue to the next roundabout and go straight ahead onto Portarlington Road, staying on it through another roundabout where you again go straight
At the following rotary take the slight left onto the Tullamore Bypass and pull in when safe to practice a controlled stop
Depart again along the Tullamore Bypass and take the next rotary exit on the left onto Daingean Road
Follow Daingean Road as it becomes O'Carroll Street, then at the roundabout take the right exit onto Harbour Street
Take the 1st right onto Colmcille Street turn left onto Clontarf Road
A short distance later turn left again to stay on Clontarf Road, which becomes Rahan Road
Turn right into Glendaniel, continue a short way and pull in for another practice stop
Move off again, then at the end of the road turn left back onto Rahan Road
Take the next right onto Kilbride Street turn left onto Patrick Street, which becomes Church Street and then Church Road as you drive straight ahead
At the roundabout exit left to stay on Church Road, then at the next roundabout turn left onto Church Hill
Pull in briefly, then move off and practice a turnabout (U-turn) on Church Hill when it is safe and legal to do so
At the end of the road turn right and continue to the roundabout, taking the right exit back onto Church Road
At the next roundabout take the slight left onto Bachelor's Walk, then at the end of the road turn left onto Clonminch Road
Follow it back toward the test centre, turning right into Central Business Park
Use the roundabout to turn around and return to your starting point at the Tullamore test centre to finish the route
